name: HighErrorRate
detects: User-visible failures: share of gateway responses with a 5xx status.
condition: 5xx / all gateway responses > 5 % over 5 s, with at least 20 requests in the window
response: Page on-call. Check which upstream is failing (ReplicaUnavailable, DatabaseUnavailable), follow the matching runbook; if a release caused it, roll back.

name: HighLatencyP95
detects: Slow service: gateway p95 latency approaching the 500 ms requirement (load spike, slow dependency).
condition: p95 of gateway latency > 300 ms over 10 s, at least 20 requests
response: Check load and CPU throttling; scale the gateway/services out or shed load (rate limits stay on). Investigate slow dependencies.

name: ReplicaUnavailable
detects: Lost redundancy: a Deployment or StatefulSet has fewer Ready pods than designed.
condition: ready pods < desired (gateway 2, auth 2, course 2, registration 2, db 2) for 1 s
response: Kubernetes restarts the pod automatically. If not back within 60 s, page on-call; check events and the node.

name: DatabaseUnavailable
detects: Registration cannot reach any database node (blocked network, both nodes down, circuit open).
response: System: registration answers 503 + Retry-After and stays up. Team: run the data-tier runbook, check db pods and NetworkPolicies, restore from the vault only if data is damaged.

name: DegradedMode
detects: A non-critical feature is served from the stale cache because the Course service is unreachable.
response: System: stale data is served with an X-Degraded header. Team: restore the Course service; data older than 10 minutes is no longer served.

name: BruteForceLogin
condition: >= 5 failed logins (auth) within 30 s (the account lockout threshold)
response: System: accounts lock for 30 s after 5 failures. Team: identify the source in the audit log, block it at the edge, notify the account owner.

name: UnauthorizedAccessSpike
detects: Requests without valid credentials: missing, forged or expired tokens.
condition: >= 5 'unauthorized_request' events at the gateway within 30 s
response: System: request denied and audited. Team: review audit events by subject and source, revoke the token or lock the account if misuse is confirmed.

name: ForbiddenAccessSpike
detects: An authenticated user repeatedly tries to read or change data of another user (broken-authorization probing).
response: System: 403 returned and audited. Team: inspect the subject in the audit log; lock the account if the pattern continues.

name: RateLimiting
detects: A client exceeds its request budget (abuse or a misbehaving client).
condition: >= 20 'rate_limited' events at the gateway within 10 s
response: System: excess requests get 429 + Retry-After. Team: identify the client; raise the limit only for a verified legitimate client.

name: MalformedRequestBurst
detects: Fuzzing or a broken client: many requests rejected by input validation.
response: System: 400/413 returned, nothing stored. Team: check the source and the client version in the access log.
